title: Derived exchange and Leray before homology
statement: For f:X→S, a geometric point s, a bounded-below injective complex J and q:K≅Q(ιJ), the derived mate transported by the source direct-image isomorphism, followed by exact strict-local sections and Leray, equals localization of the underived exchange on global sections followed by the derived sections unit and transport by p^*q.inv. No neighbourhood restriction or homology is used. All mate target comparisons in this statement use the small coordinate-ring colimit model of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data].

source.place: Tag 03Q9, final injective-complex paragraph; details of the adjunction compatibility written by P1

proof.text: Apply the injective-representative derived-exchange identity under the exact strict-local sections functor. Move its localization factor through the termwise exchange by naturality. Apply the sections-unit/Leray identity with r equal to the exact pullback localization comparison followed by pullback of q.inv. Combine the two localized termwise maps by functoriality of Q; their composite is the stated b by the definitions of whiskering and associator.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.
